# Link variants

The same Jira board under several spellings, for the link browser's "only inconsistent" filter and for "Edit link across vault".

- Lowercase: [jira](https://example.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/DATA/boards/42)
- Other text, trailing slash: [Sprint board](https://example.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/DATA/boards/42/)
- With a title: [JIRA BOARD](https://example.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/DATA/boards/42 "Team board")
- Ignored text, never edited: [here](https://example.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/DATA/boards/42)

| Where | Link |
| --- | --- |
| Table | [Jira board](https://example.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/DATA/boards/42) |
